messages:
Maya R (PM): quick sync — we're carving up Q3 roadmap items for the Dedicated launch. Need a single dependency map + critical path by EOD Friday. who's got the canonical list?
Sam T (ENG): i can start one. high level: model onboarding + quantization, runtime perf tuning, canary rollout infra, integration tests.
Liam K (Infra): infra dependencies: GPU pool provisioning, networking (VPC peering for private), and storage perf. blocking: capacity quote from cloud partner (waiting on procurement).
Ana P (Eng-Platform): platform pieces: config rollout, autoscale policies, and telemetry hooks in console. need final schema for rollout flags from product.
Jordan S (Prod-Ops): will need runbooks + SLO targets. also migration plan for existing dedicated customers.
Maya R (PM): good. let's capture owners + milestones. propose we mark these as 'must-have' vs 'nice-to-have' for GA. critical path items I think are: 1) dedicated infra ready 2) runtime perf within latency SLO 3) canary with partner org. anyone disagree?
Sam T (ENG): agree. runtime perf tied to quantization strategy — if we push a 4-bit quant we save cost but risk quality regressions. need evaluation harness and eval owners.
Ana P (Eng-Platform): adding: feature flags and fallback policy to hosted models if dedicated under capacity. that reduces risk on day-1.
Liam K (Infra): timeline constraints: GPU pool lead time ~3 weeks after order. procurement ETA Fri. if procurement slips, we shift critical path.
Maya R (PM): ok let's draft a mini dependency matrix. Sam, Ana — can you fill owners and short descriptions? I'll paste initial matrix here.
Maya R (PM): ```
ID | Workstream | Owner | Depends on | Target milestone (ETA) | Must-have?
1  | GPU capacity | Liam K | procurement sign-off | 2026-04-10 | yes
2  | Model quant + perf | Sam T | Test harness, GPU capacity | 2026-04-24 | yes
3  | Feature flags + rollout | Ana P | API schema, console hooks | 2026-04-17 | yes
4  | Canary partner integration | Jordan S | Partner onboarding, infra | 2026-05-01 | yes
5  | Extended telemetry | Ana P | console storage | 2026-05-08 | nice
```
Sam T (ENG): filling: for #2 test harness owner = me, qual criteria = <=12% quality regression on eval set and median p95 latency < 120ms.
Jordan S (Prod-Ops): for #4 partner integration: need contract tweak for data residency. legal loop is 2w. that sits before canary.
Liam K (Infra): noted. adding risk flags: procurement delay, region GPU shortages, network quota. estimated mitigation: fallback to burst capacity in another region (requires routing policy).
Ana P (Eng-Platform): will add rollout API schema PR by Tue. also need to confirm rollback path with Sam for model variant fallback.
Maya R (PM): ownership summary due: Sam (runtime + eval), Liam (infra procurement + capacity), Ana (rollout + telemetry), Jordan (canary + runbooks). owners pls ack.
Sam T (ENG): ack.
Liam K (Infra): ack.
Ana P (Eng-Platform): ack.
Jordan S (Prod-Ops): ack.
Maya R (PM): next: milestone sequencing session Thurs 10am — please bring blockers. we'll produce critical path GANTT and call out >1w risks.
Sam T (ENG): i'll bring perf numbers and eval plan.
Liam K (Infra): will bring procurement timeline and cloud partner status.
Ana P (Eng-Platform): will bring flag API draft.
Jordan S (Prod-Ops): will bring runbook skeleton and SLA draft.
deploy-bot: scheduled: maintenance window 2026-04-07 02:00-03:00 UTC — infra team notified. :wrench:
Maya R (PM): noted the maintenance window — thanks. if that slips it could affect provisioning timeline, add to risk log.
Sam T (ENG): quick q: where do we store the dependency matrix? recommend a living sheet in /product/roadmaps/dedicated-critical-path.
Maya R (PM): yep i'll create the sheet and share link in this thread once done. everyone please add a row for open items and update ETA by EOD Fri. :calendar:
Jordan S (Prod-Ops): one more: can we add a soft-launch checklist item for small customers only? reduces blast radius.
Maya R (PM): yes — add as pre-GA gating item.
Ana P (Eng-Platform): timeline note: console telemetry retention for launch set to 90d by default, can tweak post-GA.
Liam K (Infra): risk: if partner region not approved we need to reorder canary partner. flagging now.
Maya R (PM): thanks all. I'll publish meeting invite for Thurs + link to sheet. this thread will be the canonical dependency tracker until the sheet is live.
Sam T (ENG): :thumbsup:
Jordan S (Prod-Ops): :+1:
Ana P (Eng-Platform): :rocket:
